subject: HS Lending: compliance pathways & subprocessor playbook
messages:
From: Mia Grant <mia.grant@harborlending.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@harborlending.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial compliance questionnaire and residency clarifications

Hi Neha / Vanessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement at Harbor wants to kick off the formal compliance review to assess whether Redwood can be the inference provider for our mortgage servicing AI. We attached our standard security & privacy questionnaire (see attachment). A few high-priority asks from our side: 

- Can Redwood sign a DPA that includes GLBA obligations and limited BAA language (we'll provide specific PHI examples)?
- Which Redwood subprocessors will have access to tokenized PII/PHI during inference and where are those subprocessors located?
- Do you offer a VPC/private deployment variant with on-prem gateways or customer-managed keys for US-only residency?

High-level timeline: procurement would like answers and a redlined DPA within two weeks to keep the board review on schedule. Appreciate a brief note on feasibility and required next steps.

Attachment: Harbor_Lending_Security_Questionnaire_v3.pdf

Thanks,
Mia Grant
Senior Procurement Manager
Harbor Lending

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Mia Grant <mia.grant@harborlending.com>, procurement@harborlending.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial compliance questionnaire and residency clarifications

Hi Mia —

Appreciate the clear asks and the questionnaire. High level: we can support a GLBA-aligned DPA and we offer options that address PHI handling (BAA pathway) but there are tradeoffs depending on deployment mode. Short answers below, followed by proposed next steps.

1) DPA / GLBA / BAA: Redwood has a baseline DPA that we can extend for GLBA obligations. BAA is possible for specific use cases (e.g., training/inference with identifiable PHI) but typically requires a Private deployment or Dedicated capacity with explicit controls. We will circulate a redline.

2) Subprocessors & residency: Our common subprocessors (telemetry, object storage, infra partners) are documented; however, when customers require US-only residency we can (a) deploy in a customer VPC on a US region, or (b) provision a Dedicated pool where subprocessors are limited. We'll provide a subprocessor matrix and residency mapping.

3) Customer-managed KMS/HSM: Supported for Private deployments and available as an add-on for Dedicated via a customer gateway.

Proposed next steps (suggested 10 business day cadence):
- Today: Redwood to send an initial DPA draft (we'll include GLBA clauses and a BAA appendix placeholder).
- +3 business days: Security to return a subprocessor/residency matrix and evidence list (SOC 2, encryption, logging).
- +7 business days: Redwood Legal to accept first round of redlines or propose alternative language.

I'll loop in Priya (Privacy & Legal) and Karthik (Solutions) to coordinate the artifacts. If Harbor wants to prioritize a pilot, mention that and we can scope a Dedicated-proof-of-concept.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Sep 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Harbor Lending - compliance questionnaire (action items)

Team — forwarding Harbor's questionnaire and procurement timeline. I sketched a pragmatic playbook below so we can move quickly and avoid repeated asks. Please reply with who will own each artifact.

Proposed playbook (deliverables and owners):
- Redline-ready DPA (GLBA + BAA appendix placeholder) — Owner: Legal (Priya). Target: 3 business days.
- Subprocessor & residency matrix (explicit list + region) — Owner: Security/Trust (Karthik). Target: 3 business days.
- Evidence bundle: SOC 2 Type II, encryption attestation, network diagrams, logging retention — Owner: Security. Target: 5 business days.
- Deployment options doc: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private (including KMS/HSM steps + costs) — Owner: Solutions (Karthik). Target: 5 business days.
- Pilot runbook (if they want a Dedicated pilot) — Owner: Solutions + Sales (Vanessa). Target: 7 business days.

Key negotiation points to watch for:
- Data residency: Harbor will likely insist on US-only subprocessors for anything that touches consumer financial data.
- BAA scope: if they consider any customer data PHI, Legal will need a scoping call to define permitted uses.
- Audit frequency & access: Harbor may ask for on-site audits or longer retention of audit logs — decide thresholds up front.

Attachments: redwood_privacy_playbook_v1.pdf, redwood_dpa_draft_GLBA_BAA.docx

Neha

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, priya_natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Sep 2027 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Harbor Lending - compliance questionnaire (action items)

All — I'm on timelines for outreach to Harbor's security lead and will coordinate a scoping call with Priya. Karthik, please include a short BOM for Dedicated pilot costs so we can give procurement a concrete estimate.

One small ask for Legal: when you draft the GLBA clauses, let's keep the data-use language narrow and include a fallback where we state "inference-only processing without downstream storage of raw payloads" unless the customer requests otherwise. That helps with both GLBA and any PHI concerns.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@harborlending.com>

Thanks for the quick responses and the playbook. Procurement would like the DPA draft and the subprocessor matrix by next Friday (2027-09-10) to stay on our review schedule. We are amenable to a Dedicated pilot if you can provide a cost estimate and a 2-week sandbox timeline.

Also: please send a DocuSign-ready DPA after your legal review so we can circulate internally. I'll include an initial priority list of technical evidence in a separate email.
